title: Noticeable presence and feedback mentions
summary: The sample combines a single positive comment about increasing feedback visibility with several ambiguous remarks about the car’s presence, capability, or behavior in hot conditions.

positive.summary: The positive review recommends increasing feedback to a high setting so the effect is more noticeable.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined reviews mention noticeable presence, capability, or hot-car conditions without enough context to identify a clear evaluation.

limitations: The topic appears to mix unrelated subjects, including feedback settings, vehicle presence, and hot-car conditions.
Most examples are too brief to determine the specific feature being discussed or the writer’s evaluation.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all reviews on this topic.
